title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: One runnable Spanish-language staff ERP prototype for the synthetic Clínica Dental Andina. The same responsive shell connects inherited cash/payments, patients, agenda, inventory and settings with editable patient antecedents and physician/specialty/availability, consultorio and laboratory/imaging study catalogs. Self-contained, stable-ID in-memory records only. S1-S3 and S4 catalogs covered; connected study requests/results, full consultation and QR (S4-S6) remain pending. Offline smoke: PASS 207 checks; no HTTP/API/storage writes or page errors.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Unified editable resource/clinical-context workspace; demo memory only, consultation completion/study orders/QR still pending
